title: Bereitstellung nach Octopus-Muster
summary: Programm-Dossier nach den Operator-Vorgaben 16.10.2026 abends: Octopus Deploy weitgehend vollstaendig abbilden; Pipelines als YAML und Buerger erster Klasse; jede Karte weiss, in welchen Umgebungen sie laeuft; Oberflaeche nach Octopus-Vorbild, neu gedacht; zwei Umgebungen Staging und Production; Website zuerst, Staging remote; bestehendes Deployment-Panel ueberarbeiten; Secret-Management von Octopus verglichen. Inhalt: Landkarte Octopus -> Agent Orchestrator mit Stufen P1-P4 (Environments, Lifecycles, Channels, Releases, Deployments, Process, Step Templates, Targets, Workers, Variables mit Praezedenz, Library Sets, Sensitive variables, Accounts, Certificates, OIDC, Runbooks, Tenants, Config as Code, Dashboard, Environment status, Pipeline Explorer, Deployment changes, Release notes, Insights, Live status, GitOps, Platform Hub, Spaces, RBAC, Audit), Oberflaeche mit Bereich Bereitstellung (sechs Ansichten) und Workspace-Dashboard, Karten und Umgebungen, Geheimnisse nach dem Octopus-Vergleich, Umbau des bestehenden Deployments, erste Projekte, Stufen, Entscheidungen BD-D1 bis BD-D4, Karten BD-1 bis BD-5.

# Releases, standard lifecycle and deploy runs with step log on top of the AGT-3176 environments

Source: docs/operations/bereitstellung/index.html (Programm-Dossier "Bereitstellung nach Octopus-Muster", stage P1) and docs/operations/integrierte-plattform/index.html section 6. Read AGENTS.md first. Robert, 16.10.2026: "Wir wollen den Octopus-Teil ziemlich vollständig abbilden", every project gets an environment and a pipeline view, rethought; two environments for now: Staging and Production.

Backend for stage P1 (sections 2, 4 and 8): immutable releases created when the integration branch builds green (artifact digests, commit, process and variable versions, included cards), the standard lifecycle (Staging automatic after integration, Production with approval by Owner or Maintainer), deploy runs per environment with a persisted step log, redeploy and rollback to the previous release, audit entries for every change. Build on the environment model and deploy job of AGT-3176 (integrated on develop before this card starts). API endpoints for the shared data contract, including EnvironmentStatus per project and a workspace matrix. Tests for release immutability, lifecycle rules, approval, redeploy, rollback and the status projection.

Shared data contract for P1 (use these names in API and UI): Environment {id, projectId, name, order, kind: staging|production}; Release {id, projectId, version, commitSha, artifactDigests[], processVersion, variablesVersion, cardKeys[], createdAtUtc, channel}; Deployment {id, releaseId, environmentId, state: queued|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled|awaiting-approval, startedAtUtc, finishedAtUtc, approvedBy, steps: [{name, state, startedAtUtc, finishedAtUtc, logRef}]}; EnvironmentStatus {environment, currentRelease, currentDeployment, newerRelease, cardsSinceLastDeploy[], health: healthy|unhealthy|unknown}.

Rules: tests inject the clock (TestClockGuardTests), every ProcessStartInfo sets CreateNoWindow = true, no empty catch blocks, no whole-file line-ending rewrites, component-size baselines must not rise, new execution routes registered in PublicDemoExecutionProfileTests. Report the result SHA in status.md.

# Cards know their environments: badges per environment, board filter, cards since the last deploy, release notes from cards

Source: docs/operations/bereitstellung/index.html (Programm-Dossier "Bereitstellung nach Octopus-Muster", stage P1) and docs/operations/integrierte-plattform/index.html section 6. Implement section 4 on top of BD-1: every card shows its environments (time, release, state, also "not yet in Production"); the board filters by environment state; each environment lists the cards that the next deploy adds; release notes are generated from the included cards in product language; a rollback marks the cards of the withdrawn release; a production failure creates a card linked to the release.
